findings.detail: Full context is visible but other batches record IDs cannot be referenced; supersession/intervention response linkage can be lost.
Primary citation overlap is structural ownership, not semantic entailment or duplicate detection.

cases.literal_rationale: The prefix reports that a photo of the solar readings was attached and sent to the landlord, and the attachment text describes a meter reading. No repair or other work is evidenced, so I propose no further action on this prefix. This is not a formal closure of a request.
semantic_notes: Reading16845, null unit, appears hedge and absent timestamp preserved. Meter1000imp/kWh is separate rating, not reading.
Wrapped warning-label sentence is grounded by two exact adjacent spans; current single-span equality diagnostic is a false positive.
No request entity still prevents request-linked representation; conclude is not formal request closure.
Property and repeated solar-system identity fragmentation improved relative to v1; unresolved attachment80 identity remains explicit.

cases.literal_rationale: Propose human review to reconcile the inspection summary with a specific finding in the attached report and decide whether tenant follow-up is appropriate. The recorded review prompt is still only a requirement, not evidence that review occurred or a response was sent.

one-recorded-defect: b003:r17 quote contains 1, but value only ratings

semantic_notes: Actual property subject plus location_text avoids v1 Bedroom1-as-property binding. Wall asset itself remains absent, but physical condition is representable without inventing that entity.
Negative booleans retain evidence-of scope; detector attributes retain tested-and-working, not merely presence.
Signature time is no longer paraphrased as report receipt.
Five repeated checklist reports exist in both detail and report-summary batches. They are duplicated source reports, not independent verification.
Four wrapped-quote equality diagnostics are false positives; Utility Room citation is genuinely wrong (p3:L41 rather than heading p3:L36), and blocking_effect has missing field evidence.

Frozen decision input has mixed reference namespace: supersedes_record_id b001:r1 and responds_to_record_id b001:r3 remain canonical while record IDs use compact aliases. Final action references still decode validly.
Escalation proposes reconciliation of email no-issues versus reported wall defect. This is a possible choice, not a demonstrated necessity or semantic correctness result.

coverage_summary.unit: 16 pre-output selected claim expectations, not all possible claims
coverage_summary.limitations: Coverage does not mean every field citation is valid. Dog flap location has wrong citation; repeated reports and composite ratings remain. No overall semantic accuracy score.

cross_batch_review.limitation: Supersession and response-to links in020 occur within b001 and survive canonical namespacing. Cross-batch linkage remains unsupported generally; no example of a required lost link established in these two probes.
